modern: How easy it is to push away and wipe out every impression that is troublesome or unsuitable, and immediately to be in complete tranquillity.
original: How easy it is to repel and to wipe away every impression which is troublesome or unsuitable, and immediately to be in all tranquillity.
notification: How easy it is to push away and wipe out every impression that is troublesome or unsuitable, and immediately to be in complete tranquillity.
notification_original: How easy it is to repel and to wipe away every impression which is troublesome or unsuitable, and immediately to be in all tranquillity.

explained.summary: You can drop a troubling or unhelpful thought almost as soon as it arrives, and with it, find calm straight away. Marcus says this is easy, which is partly encouragement to himself. The point is that a disturbing impression only takes hold if you keep it and add to it.
